_note: Every cutscene (M8; DESIGN.md 'Cutscenes'), in one timeline format: story/cutsceneTimeline.js explains positions (in an anchor's frame: x right, y up, z ahead), camera keys and events. Anchors: player, home, homeDoor, hut, witch, trailCam (the camera that saw her, else camera 1), trailCam:<number> (that camera: clip.night1 is the storm shelter's camera six, M9.1), nearestClearing, clearing:<encounter id>. style: cctv | firstPerson | sweep | black. look: config.postFX.looks. hour: the grade and sky while it plays (else the clock's). light: the camera's light on the actors (else config.cutscenes.actorLight for its look). fps: a CCTV feed's frame rate. world: 'run' keeps the world going (else it holds still). Events: line (dialogue.json id; radio true/false), text, move, pose (stand/kneel/down), show, hide, flare, glitch, fade, emit, lookAt, shake, osd (cut to another camera: look, hour, osd), sfx. rewatch: once played it goes on the comms room's monitors. 'placeholder': the shot is a stand-in until its encounter session makes it properly. Every cutscene is in the debug menu's Cutscenes category (Aaron, Session 11).

cutscenes._cut: Aaron (Nov 14): nobody speaks in it now (linesAfter: the lines below play once it ends, skipped or not), so a new player can skip it without fearing they will miss what to do: the UFO, the smoke, done in half the time.

cutscenes.name: Earl Pruitt's tape: camera four, Night 1 (trail cam)
cutscenes._note: Session 16 (M9.3; DESIGN 'Storm shelter', 'The trail-cam tapes'): Earl's tape, handed in at the comms room (StormShelter plays it as the tapes are handed in; then it's on the monitors). Camera four at the shelter clearing's edge (anchor stormShelter: walking in from home, x right, z ahead), Night 1. The witch is already there, low over the ground beside the hatch (the first sigil going in). Earl and his two kids hurry in from the trees and pull up short. A still beat. She turns, far too fast; they scatter out of frame, the kids one way into the trees and Earl the other, and she goes after him. The kill is never shown. The clearing empties; the last seconds are the hatch alone and the sigil's faint glow. The family watch it in the comms room: Wyatt first, Ellen explains, Junie catches the kids running off (Aaron: maybe they got away), Wyatt ties the glow to the sigil Tom dug up.

cutscenes.name: The outpost: the dogfight through the hunting rifle's scope
cutscenes._note: Session 17 (M9.4; DESIGN.md 'Overrun military outpost' beat 6): the first time Tom raises the hunting rifle's scope up the outpost's watchtower (or, if he never climbs it, as he crosses the barricade). Through the scope (look scope: a 4x round view), a patrol plane chasing a craft of lights, trading fire; the craft's ray hits the plane, the plane's guns hit the craft; the plane dives in, the craft limps away south and comes down far off. Both come down where the map puts the crashed plane and the crashed UFO (Session 17, Aaron). Anchors (from Outpost.dogfightAnchors): dogfight (Tom's eye, facing the plane's crash site), fight (the fight, along that line), planeCrash and ufoCrash (each facing away from Tom). near 60: the scope sees past the trees round the outpost and the tower itself (they'd fill the view). The plane and the craft are unlit (they read as shapes by day and by their lights at night). Lines inside are cleared if it's skipped; Ellen's after it plays either way (Outpost). The crashes' flashes light the sky over the treeline (over: no depth test), and their smoke stands tall enough to show over it.

cutscenes._note: Session 25, redone Session 32 (Aaron: too rushed: it should jump out, be seen for a few seconds, raise the pistol and start shooting before control comes back). cutscenes.name: The crashed plane: the Mothman's last strike smashes Tom's radio (first person)
cutscenes._note: Session 26 (HANDOVER default 1: Junie is taken in both endings): driven off, the Mothman makes one last low pass on its way out and rakes Tom. The radio on his chest goes mid-line (Ellen's). Static, then nothing. The night passes (the encounter skips to dawn): nobody could reach him.

cutscenes.name: Junie is taken: the south path trail camera, the night Tom lost (trail cam)
cutscenes._note: Session 26 (DESIGN.md 'Junie is taken'): the night Tom lay out at the crashed plane. The Caller spoke on the radio in his voice; the family went out after him. Anchor junieWoods (encounters/JunieTaken.js: config.junieTaken.clipFrom metres past the fence toward the plane, ahead = away from home, toward the treeline). A camera on a post by the south path, looking out to the trees. They come out with torches, calling; Tom's voice answers from the left, then the right, then ahead; they split; Junie's torch goes on into the trees and out. Ellen and Wyatt run after it and out of frame. The last seconds are empty trees, and one word. Its beats are timed to each caption's reading length (config.subtitles). Session 33 (Aaron: trim it): cut from 53.7 s to about half: they come out calling, his voice answers, they split to both sides, he calls Junie, she goes; five captions dropped.

cutscenes.name: Day 2: the thing at the campers' fire (sweep)

I love a cutscene which gives you a chance to look at the new enemy'). The Screamer's first sighting, on Day 2's ride out to Earl's. Anchor campScreamer (encounters/Campsite.js): its feet, z ahead out of the camp's open side (the way Tom comes), the fire and the lean-tos behind it. Its back to us, across the open ground; in and low; it turns round (campsite:turn) and screams (campsite:scream: Campsite.figureScream; the dead come up out of the dirt either side of it; the world runs on); held on its face. Afterwards (skipped or not) it goes back into the ground and Ellen says what it did.

cutscenes.name: Arriving at the clearing crew's camp (establishing sweep)
cutscenes._note: Build queue item 1 (scaffolding): anchor dozerCamp (encounters/CordonDozer.js: ahead is up the cut to the machine; x right as you walk in). High over the stumps, the strip running back toward the fence; down past the log deck and the tent; in on the dozer, its blade against the first tree they didn't fell.

cutscenes.name: Arriving at the old church (establishing sweep)
cutscenes._note: Session 26 (DESIGN.md: an arrival sweep): anchor oldChurch (encounters/OldChurch.js: ahead is up the path to the door; x right as you walk in, the model's -x). High over the lychgate, the leaning steeple against the sky; down over the crooked stones and the row of eleven; in along the path to the door's black opening. No one on the radio: the church is south of the comms line. The wind, and the bell's yoke creaking once.

cutscenes.name: The stairs in the woods: the first sight (first person)
cutscenes._note: Session 26 (DESIGN.md 'Stairs in the woods'): Tom comes out of the trees and there it is: a house's staircase, standing alone in the clearing, clean, lit by nothing. A long held look, the view drawn to it. No one on the radio down here; a thin, wrong tone.

cutscenes.name: The stairs in the woods: climbing them (first person)
cutscenes._note: Session 26: Tom climbs. The steps creak under him like a house's at night; the view tips up toward the top step and the air past it, the fog closes to grey, and he's somewhere else (the place beyond).

cutscenes.name: The place beyond: Junie found (first person)
cutscenes._note: Session 26 (DESIGN.md: take the silent path three times in a row to find Junie): the last clearing, wider, quiet. Junie in its middle with her back to him, kneeling, hands over her ears, saying she isn't listening. She turns. It did everyone's voice all night and she never answered. She runs to him. Anchor beyondFind (PlaceBeyond's 'beyond:found': the clearing's middle, ahead the way Tom faces). Then they go down the stairs (encounters/Stairs.js).

cutscenes.name: Junie comes home (the compound, by the cabin door)
cutscenes._note: Session 26: Tom brings Junie through the gate. Ellen and Wyatt come out of the cabin door at a run; Ellen goes down on her knees to her; Wyatt says sorry; Junie says Dad came and didn't follow it either; Ellen to Tom. Anchor homeDoor (ahead is away from the door, toward the gate). The family are three at home again afterwards (encounters/Stairs.js: junieHome).

cutscenes.name: Arriving at Milo's barn: the siege (establishing sweep)
cutscenes._note: Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js): anchor milosBarn (its frame: x right as you walk up the lane, z ahead). Over the lane: the red barn ringed by the dead, the fence, the cars across the lane; down onto the yard where a clown is bounding about, throwing knives (the world runs: he's really doing it). His chuckle.

cutscenes.name: Milo opens the car gates with one hand (first person)
cutscenes._note: Milo's barn (DESIGN.md: the car gates): the dead down, Tom at the cars. Milo bounds over, grabs a bonnet in one hand and swings the car aside like a gate, then the other; bows, beckons. Polite, welcoming and impossible. The encounter moves him and the cars (emitted events: milo:gatesOpen, milo:bow, milo:beckon); the view follows him (anchor milo).

cutscenes.name: Thrown out of Milo's barn (first person)
cutscenes._note: Milo's barn: Tom shot at him. After 'I was in character!', a shove, the world tips, black; Tom's put down outside the cars (milo:out) and the picture comes back on the gate shut in his face.

cutscenes.name: Arriving at the railway cutting (establishing sweep)
cutscenes._note: Session 27 (encounters/RailwayCutting.js): anchor railwayCutting (ahead: along the line toward the engine's front; x right as you face it). High over the cutting's back mouth, the line running away between its rock walls; down along the coaches, their windows black, a tree up through the first one's roof; past the tender to the engine; low at last by the cowcatcher, on the lantern set down on the ties ahead of it, still burning. No one on the radio: it's south of the comms line. The wind, the train ticking as it cools, though it's been cold for a hundred and twenty years.

cutscenes.name: Arriving at the sawmill (establishing sweep)
cutscenes._note: Session 28 (encounters/Sawmill.js): anchor sawmill (ahead: up the mill road into the yard; x right as you walk in). High over the mill road, the shed's tin roof beyond two black cars; down to the nearer car's open boot (lime, shovels, a roll of tarp); across the yard along the drag marks to the row under the tarps; into the shed, low, to the man in the suit on the floor with the chainsaw stood in him. Nobody speaks. The wind, the loose tin on the roof, flies.

cutscenes.name: Arriving at the moonshiners' holler (establishing sweep)
cutscenes._note: Session 29 (encounters/Holler.js): anchor holler (ahead: up the hollow from its mouth; x right as you walk in: the model's x negated). High over the mouth between the two ridges; down low to the first trap (the stump gun, its line slack, the man in the suit face down in front of it); along the floor past the cans on their wire to the lookout; on up to the still's yard, the family standing about it; in close on the gauge, its needle in the red. Nobody speaks. Wind in the laurel, the cans ticking, the still boiling.

cutscenes.name: Arriving at the abandoned mineshaft (establishing sweep)
cutscenes._note: Session 30 (encounters/Mineshaft.js): anchor mineshaft (ahead: the way the track walks in; x right as you walk in: the model's x negated). High over the track, the headframe black against the sky; down to the company's sign and the army's tape across it; in through the office door to the tag board, eleven tags still on their hooks; across the yard to the lift's control box, its tray empty and the leads hanging; then up the headframe's legs to the sheave. Nobody speaks. Wind, and the headframe working in it.

cutscenes.name: Arriving at the crashed plane (establishing sweep)
cutscenes._note: Session 32 (Aaron: a sweep from a higher vantage point, with a hint of the alien; encounters/CrashedPlane.js arrive): anchor crashSite (ahead: up the gouge to the wreck; x right as you walk up it, the model's -x). High over the tail end of the gouge, the furrow running away to the wreck; down along it past the sheared wing; then low and off to the side, toward the wing the plane kept, where something small and grey is bent over a row of gun parts and doesn't look up. Nobody speaks until it's over (then Wyatt, then Ellen, over the radio). Wind, and metal ticking.

cutscenes.name: Out of the mine ahead of the fire (the landing, the cage, the collar)
cutscenes._note: Session 31 (encounters/MineBottom.js startCine): anchors given by the encounter: mineLanding (the cage's floor at the bottom of the shaft; ahead: down the drift; x right of that) and mineCollar (the surface set's own frame, as sweep.mineshaft's). The encounter moves the cart, the fire and the shaft's walls on this clock (config.mineshaft.escape.cine). From beside the rails on the landing: the drift's mouth lit orange, the cart coming out of it hard and braking. From inside the cage: the fire round the last of the drift and into the landing; the cage snatches upward and the shaft's walls come down over it. Black. The collar by day or night: a thump underfoot, smoke and a lick of fire up the shaft, the headframe working. Nobody speaks.
